dropped.claim: The combination of strong historical growth (11.6% 3-year CAGR), expanding margins (8.9% operating margin), and solid free cash flow generation ($481.4M) demonstrates execution capability in a well-funded market. However, three factors create meaningful uncertainty about sustainability: (1) backlog declined from $31.6B to $31.4B despite 12.6% revenue growth, suggesting potential deceleration ahead; (2) the first-ever full-year DoD continuing resolution creates near-term execution risk through delayed program starts; and (3) debt nearly doubling to $2.9B while operating cash flow remains below FY 2022 levels ($547.0M vs $745.6M) despite 39% revenue growth constrains financial flexibility. The thesis survives but requires monitoring backlog trends and debt service capacity as leading indicators of whether the growth trajectory can continue.
